'''Melon''' was a type of [[Fruit/Legends|fruit]]. There were several types of melon, including [[Beelpop melon]], [[Honey melon/Legends|Honey Melon]], [[Hubba gourd/Legends|hubba melon]], [[Rakmelon/Legends|rakmelon]], [[ramba melon]], [[watermelon]],<ref name="Star Wars: Return of the Jedi novelization">[[Star Wars: Return of the Jedi (novelization)|''Star Wars Episode VI: Return of the Jedi'' novel]]</ref> [[wk'ou melon]] and [[Maroj Melon|Maroj melon]].
